title: Ship a token change from Figma to code and back
prompt: A Northwind designer wants to darken `color/text/subtle` because it fails contrast in the Tidewater dark theme. The JSON in the tokens repository is the source of truth, and the Figma library is a mirror. Put the steps of the change in order.
hints: Nothing reaches the published Figma library before it has been released from the repository.
Checks run on the pull request, before humans approve it.
explanation: The designer explores in a branch, so nothing published changes yet. The exported JSON enters the source of truth through a pull request, where CI validates names, references and contrast and builds every platform. Humans review with that evidence, the release publishes a new version with a changelog, and only then is the released JSON imported into the main library and published, so Figma mirrors exactly what shipped.

items.propose: Designer tries the darker value in a branch of the Figma library file
items.export: Export the changed modes as DTCG JSON and open a pull request in the tokens repository
items.ci: CI runs the naming, reference and contrast checks and builds CSS, Swift and Kotlin
items.review: A core designer and engineer review the pull request and its visual diffs
items.release: Merge and publish a new tokens version with a changelog entry
items.sync: Import the released JSON into the main library's variables and publish the library update
